Loteki Supernatural Being.question: The victory at _____ in 1999 added to a remarkable 31 best in show trophies, including winning the World Dog Show in Helsinki, Finland, and the Royal Canadian Show in 1998 in the same show year
Loteki Supernatural Being.fact: In 1999, Kirby became the first Papillon to win best in show at Westminster. He also became the oldest dog to ever win at Westminster at eight years old, a record which would stand until 2009 with the ten-year-old Sussex Spaniel Clussexx Three D Grinchy Glee.
